# The one maintained list of macOS-sensitive paths for CI.
#
# Any changed path that matches a pattern below starts the macOS lane
# immediately in .github/workflows/ci.yml.
#
# Files whose old or new content contains a macOS cfg gate
# (`target_os = "macos"`, `target_vendor = "apple"`, or
# `not(target_os = "linux")`) are matched automatically by
# scripts/macos-ci-paths.sh. So list here the paths whose
# macOS behavior that scan cannot see: modules that wrap macOS behavior
# without naming it, dependencies, and build and CI inputs.
#
# When you add a new macOS-specific module or wrapper, add its path in the
# same change.
#
# Everything else is covered by the nightly run in
# .github/workflows/macos-nightly.yml. Blank lines and `#` lines are ignored.

# CI definitions for the macOS lane and for this filter.
.github/workflows/*
.github/actions/*
.github/macos-ci-paths.txt
scripts/macos-ci-paths.sh
scripts/test-macos-ci-paths.sh

# Toolchain, dependencies, lint config, and build scripts.
Cargo.toml
*/Cargo.toml
Cargo.lock
rust-toolchain*
.cargo/*
clippy.toml
build.rs
*/build.rs

# Native desktop app, built on AppKit and WebKit on macOS.
mj-desktop/*

# Dictation: CoreAudio capture through cpal, and the client transport that runs it.
voice-worker/*
mj-chat/src/speech.rs
